conflictPairs.text: Main Figure 4 stopped-flow caption says 6.67 mM AgClO4 before 1:1 mixing; Figure 5 says 6.66 mM. Both captions are retained; common 3.33 mM post-mix value is approximate.

Main p.4 body says both microfluidic XAS and stopped-flow observe exchange in 3.33 mM Ag+, whereas Figure 4 assigns the microfluidic trace 5 mM AgClO4 before side-stream mixing. Side-stream diffusion prevents a simple 1:1 chip dilution assignment; preserve both statements without merging conditions.
SI Figure S2 phase sample is 2.8 mM CdSe/5 mM AgClO4 chip reacted; main Figure 3 XAS uses 1.4/5 mM, so its tetragonal phase cannot be assigned to the same physical aliquot.
Figure 1d SEM depicts the silicon microchannel cross-section, not a nanocrystal morphology image.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
